purpose: test-only certificate for capture-time outer Owner identity, immutable template/node lookup, owner replay and complete retained outer-frame projection

captured_template.capture_shape: capture_template appends the capture-time outer TemplateNode::Owner after the saved-suffix nodes, sets its inner edge to the preceding root, then sets ResumeTemplate.root to the appended node index.
captured_template.lookup_rule: resolve exact (handle,node_index) from the owning immutable ResumeTemplate; require node_index == captured_template.root == captured_template.nodes.len()-1; require nodes[node_index] == TemplateNode::Owner { inner: prior_root, original: containing }; validate the root/inner edge against the source-derived captured layout.
prohibitions: accepting another Owner at a different valid index as the capture-time outer Owner

owner_replay.rule: capture_root_index must be read from the immutable template; node_index must equal capture_root_index and the final appended Owner coordinate; actual node lookup, control-map resolution, branch disposition, chosen owner and pushed OwnerReturn form one ordered source-derived replay.

frame_projection.rule: retain complete ordered projection with source-derived endpoints and mandatory connected boundaries; saved suffix and retained outer frames are distinct projections.

request_consumer.rule: link captured template through replay and complete outer projection to the distinct write operation actual receiving consumer; permission, request creation, consumer handling and residual flow remain distinct.

mutations.wrong_positive_node_index: prefer an alternate valid Owner coordinate if one exists; reject because it is not captured_template.root, even though it is an Owner; otherwise use a wrong in-bounds coordinate and reject exact coordinate mismatch.
mutations.rule: a mutation is invalid evidence unless the intended target exists and the applicable certificate record changed before rejection is asserted.

authority: test-only observations and validators; no runtime semantics, source fixture, expected output, production implementation, source-domain, dependency or theorem-scope change
